plan.summary: Bumps the `undici` HTTP client dependency from `^6.19.2` to `^7.2.0` to get the keep-alive fix. The lockfile now pins 7.2.0. The new version raises the minimum Node engine from `>=18.17` to `>=20.18.1`.
plan.riskRationale: A major version bump of an HTTP client can change runtime behavior. The new Node engine floor (>=20.18.1) can break environments on older Node. No code or tests change in this PR.
plan.storyArc: The manifest requests undici 7. The lockfile records the resolved version and its stricter Node requirement. The lockfile follows the manifest, so one topic covers both.

topics.title: Upgrade undici to 7.2.0 and raise the Node engine floor
topics.narrativeBrief: What does moving undici from 6 to 7 change for consumers? Connect the `package.json` range to the lockfile version and the new `engines.node` of `>=20.18.1`. Verify that the project's own Node target meets that floor.
